articles.title: Felix Lombardi, 76, Volunteer Firefighter
articles.deck: Friends remember Felix Lombardi for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Felix Lombardi died in April at home on Locust Lane, at the age of 76. Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Eastgate Volunteer Fire Co. in his or her name.
Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Felix Lombardi spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.

articles.title: Then & Now: Vernon Street in 1989 and Today
articles.deck: A photo from the Millrace County Historical Society shows the same corner as it looked decades ago.
body: A 1989 photograph from the Millrace County Historical Society shows Vernon Street from the corner of Fairview Street.

Someone took the same picture from the same spot this month, holding the camera at about the same height. Most of the houses are still standing, though the porches and the trees have changed a good deal.
